context: A boss reviews a corporate-PR challenge
purpose: Teach: 未解決/裏切る/見せかけ/煽る/争わ/退け/減らさ/鈍い

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、未解決の課題、優先的に取り組め。
lines.en: Industry challenges we haven't solved yet—we prioritize them.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive. Sharp attack on the opening. No wasted breath. A statement of fact, not negotiation. Brief pause between clauses. Authority without raising voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。顧客の信頼、裏切るような対応、避けます。
lines.en: Understood. We won't betray our customers' trust—not in anything we put out there.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. Nods slightly with the opening word. Steady eye contact. Deliberate pace. Emphasis lands on the commitment, not the avoidance. Reliable tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 透明性を見せかける広報、ダメだ。
lines.en: Fake transparency in PR—that doesn't work. Not acceptable.
lines.style: Sharp rejection. Slight pause after the dash to let it land. Lower register on the second phrase. Finality without anger. The tone of someone who's seen this fail before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: メディアが煽る場面、冷静に対応します。
lines.en: When the media starts stirring things up, we stay calm. Clear heads.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Steady, unhurried. Breath controlled. Implicit promise in the tone—'we won't panic, we won't overcorrect.' Slight emphasis on the calm, not the chaos.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合と争わずに、独自路線で。
lines.en: Don't compete directly with competitors. We chart our own course.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly philosophical. Slower pace. Weight on 'own course'—this is the principle he believes in. No aggression, no defensiveness. Just clarity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。批判を退ける論調、慎重に発信します。
lines.en: Yes. And we'll be thoughtful about how we answer criticism—measured responses only.
lines.style: Attentive, respectful. Acknowledges the instruction. Thoughtful cadence. The word 'thoughtful' mirrors his boss's values back. Not robotic—genuinely engaged.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: コスト、減らさずに、品質、保て。
lines.en: We don't cut costs to maintain quality. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firm, clear. Direct declaration. No hedging. Weight on both demands equally—the double line is intentional, not contradictory. The tone of someone who understands the stakes.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 反応が鈍い客層、丁寧にアプローチします。
lines.en: For customers who are slow to respond, we'll be patient and thoughtful. Take the time.
lines.style: Gentle underneath the professionalism. Empathetic attention. Slower pace—matching the patience being described. No frustration, no impatience. The voice of someone who sees the person, not just the metric.
